Name: Rideable Deer (Content Patcher)
Author: hojichas
Description:
[size=5]Rideable Deer[/size]

Replaces the horse with a deer of your choice (including a brown deer, pink deer, and red elk based on Yakul from Princess Mononoke). Much thanks to [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/261/?tab=1&navtag=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.nexusmods.com%2Fstardewvalley%2Fajax%2Fmoddescription%2F%3Fid%3D261%26preview%3D&pUp=1]avalitor[/url] for the redesigned running animation!

[b]Aug. 5, 2018:[/b] Can now be used with Content Patcher thanks to ﻿[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/56376082-justtodownloadthings/]JustToDownloadThings[/url]﻿!

[size=4]Install for Content Patcher[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI.[/url]﻿
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher.[/url]﻿
[*]﻿Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods﻿.
[*]﻿Access the config file from the mod folder and choose your settings.

[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=3]Config Options[/size]
[list]
[*]"Browndeer"
[*]"Pinkdeer"
[*][size=2]"Redelk"[/size]
[*][size=2]﻿[/size]"Redelkreins"
[/list]
